reuse.why: Introduces one guard function and calls it from the link handlers before anything is created; no existing helper for this check existed.

duplication.why: The rule is written once in assertNotLinkedElsewhere and only the call is repeated per provider.

placement.why: Guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers and runs before findOrCreateBank and the sync call.

scope.why: Only the guard, three call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: The guard is clean, but it is wired into only three of the five provider link handlers, so Akahu and Enable Banking can still double-link and a future provider can easily forget it.

one_place.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts is called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount and linkPluggyAiAccount but not by linkAkahuAccount or linkEnableBankingAccount
